cases.legacy_hypothesis: application, review, settlement and subscription management

evidence.statement: An applicant submits a partner application and receives an application number.
The same applicant edits or withdraws the application before review.
A compliance reviewer approves or rejects the application and records a review decision.
A finance operator activates the approved partner settlement account.
A user subscribes to one notification topic.
The same user unsubscribes from that notification topic.
A platform operator suspends a topic for all users under governance permission.

cases.legacy_hypothesis: Eligibility, calculation, payment, receipt and notification are separate capabilities because they use different technical components.

evidence.statement: After a disruption is confirmed, the system creates one compensation case for one event and traveler.
A rules engine checks itinerary state, delay duration and responsibility, then writes the result to the same compensation case.
Amount calculation uses cabin, disruption range and traveler tier to produce the proposed amount for the same case.
Event ID, traveler ID and compensation type form one idempotency key that prevents duplicate issuance.
Only after eligibility and amount are fixed does the payment adapter create a payment instruction for that case.
The payment receipt only updates the original case issuance state and payment reference; it creates no new business request.
A failed-payment retry reuses the original case and issuance decision and cannot recalculate an independent compensation.
Eligibility snapshot, amount basis and payment reference are stored in one issuance audit record.
A compensation receipt is generated automatically only after successful issuance and cannot be requested or approved separately.
The terminal case state triggers the result notification, which cites that case's issuance conclusion.
Eligibility, pricing, payment, receipt and notification share one compensation case ID end to end.
These internal steps have no separate menu, permission or business terminal state; externally there is one compensation issuance operation.

cases.legacy_hypothesis: One record lifecycle capability is sufficient because all functions share a module and master table.

evidence.statement: Retention rules support independent drafting, version approval and scheduled activation.
An active rule calculates an expiry date for one record by category and stores the applied rule version.
A rule change independently triggers a bulk recalculation that replaces existing record expiry dates without changing legal-hold or custody state.
A specially authorized operator places a legal hold on a record using a case number and reason.
A held record cannot enter disposal even after its retention period expires.
Releasing a hold requires separate authorization and creates a release record without modifying retention rules.
The system builds a pending-disposal list only from expired records that are not held.
A disposal request requires dual approval and may be independently rejected before execution.
Completed disposal creates an immutable certificate and moves the record to a disposed terminal state.
The current custodian initiates responsibility transfer and receives a pending transfer request ID for the receiving department.
The receiving department rejects a pending transfer request; custody remains unchanged and no hold or disposal state changes.
The receiving department accepts a pending transfer request, updating the responsible party and handover chain while retention, hold and disposal eligibility remain independent.

cases.legacy_hypothesis: Each query route is a capability, while every write command belongs to one work-order operation capability.

evidence.statement: List query filters work orders by state, depot and creation date without changing state.
Detail query returns base data, processing history and current assignee for one work order without changing state.
Vehicle query returns related maintenance work orders through the same result model.
Overdue query adds a planned-completion-time predicate to the common query and creates no business record.
Combined search accepts fault code and text filters and still returns the same read-only work-order view.
Assignment selects a team and worker and moves a new work order to assigned.
Reassignment records a reason and changes responsibility under the same responsibility-confirmation rules.
Suspension requires a reason and pauses both execution and deadline timing.
Resume reverses suspension, continues timing and preserves elapsed duration.
A safety lock prevents completion and release of critical material when risk is detected.
Only a safety reviewer may release the safety lock; ordinary executors cannot.
Administrative closure moves a stale or duplicate order directly to an exception-closed terminal state without normal acceptance.
Administrative closure uses an independent permission and records basis, operator and prior state.

cases.level1_capability: 共享实验仪器预约治理
cases.legacy_hypothesis: 资质、日历、配额、冲突和入口渠道应按技术组件拆成多个二级能力

evidence.statement: 研究人员在网页端选择仪器和时段后，预约门户返回其对该仪器时段的预约资格判定。
研究人员在移动端提交所选仪器时段的预检后，移动入口返回其对该仪器时段的预约资格判定。
研究人员提交培训记录编号后，资质组件返回其对所选仪器时段的预约资格判定。
研究人员提交样品风险等级后，安全规则组件返回其对所选仪器时段的预约资格判定。
研究人员选择受限实验区内的仪器后，区域权限组件返回其对所选仪器时段的预约资格判定。
研究人员在周预约额度已用尽时发起预检后，配额组件返回其不具备所选仪器时段预约资格的判定。
研究人员选择与已有预约重叠的时段后，冲突组件返回其不具备所选仪器时段预约资格的判定。
研究人员选择处于停用窗口的仪器时段后，日历组件返回其不具备该仪器时段预约资格的判定。
研究人员在批量预检页勾选一个候选时段后，预检组件返回其对该仪器时段的预约资格判定。
研究人员通过开放接口提交单个时段预检后，接口组件返回其对该仪器时段的预约资格判定。

cases.level1_capability: 职业技能考试考务治理
cases.legacy_hypothesis: 报名、监考、特殊安排、成绩复核和证书均位于考务模块，应合并为一个二级能力

evidence.statement: 考生提交科目报名后，报名规则形成其是否取得该科目应考资格的结果。
考生撤回科目报名后，报名规则形成其不再保有该科目应考资格的结果。
监考员接受指定场次的派遣后，考务模块形成其取得该场次执考权限的结果。
监考员退出指定场次的派遣后，考务模块形成其不再保有该场次执考权限的结果。
考生提交延长答题时长申请后，特殊安排审批形成该申请的批准或驳回决定。
考生按申请编号查询特殊安排后，审批查询返回该申请既有的批准或驳回决定。
考生提交成绩异议后，成绩复核形成该科目成绩的最终裁决。
考生按复核编号查询结果后，复核查询返回该科目既有的最终裁决。
考生在成绩合格后申请电子证书，证书服务形成该考生的电子合格证书。
考生按证书编号查看已签发凭证后，证书服务返回其既有的电子合格证书。

cases.legacy_hypothesis: 额度查看、额度调整、申请审批和资金支付均属于资助申请流程，应合并为一个二级能力

evidence.statement: 项目负责人按项目编号查询后，额度页面返回该项目当前可申请资助上限。
项目负责人从研究类别入口查询指定项目后，额度页面返回该项目当前可申请资助上限。
项目负责人通过移动端查看指定项目额度后，移动端返回该项目当前可申请资助上限。
项目负责人提交经确认的预算变更后，额度重算以新的资助上限替换该项目原资助上限。
项目负责人按重算批次查询后，重算页面返回该项目已替换生效的新资助上限。
项目负责人提交资助申请后，审批流程形成该申请的批准或驳回决定。
项目负责人按审批编号查询后，审批页面返回该申请既有的批准或驳回决定。
项目负责人对已批准批次发起拨款后，资金执行形成该批次划付成功或失败的结果。
项目负责人按支付流水查询后，执行页面返回该批次既有的资金划付结果。
项目负责人通过移动端查询支付批次后，移动端返回该批次既有的资金划付结果。
